raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation Issue: #42170. Currently, for a colocate worker, we can turn on --enable-prefill-cp for prefill and --enable-cp-decode-attn-tp for decode. In this way, prefill batch computes in a CP manner (split token) and decode batch computes in a TP manner (split weight). However, decode TP computes full batch is not friendly for high concurrency. Therefore, this PR provides a prefill CP decode DP option for a colocate worker. ## Modifications This colocate decode DP modification is within model forward and doesn't affect the scheduler. 1. Each rank selects different query rows and pads the local batch at runtime for the subsequent projection, indexer, attention computation. 2. Each rank computes compressor using full batch and write the full KVcache into kv pool. 3. After attention, Allgather is performed to collect the attn results of each rank and subsequent mhc/moe will not be affected. 4. For Dspark draft forward, the attention remains TP even if --cp-decode-attn-mode dp is set. ## Accuracy Tests ## Speed Tests and Profiling We did test on 4*H20-3e and tested the cases of cache hit 93% and cache hit 70%. +    parallel = get_parallel()

+        mode.is_decode() or mode.is_target_verify()
+    )
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class CPDecodeQueryLayout:
+    """A graph-stable contiguous query shard; padded ranks still gather output."""
+
+    rows: int
+    rank: int
+    size: int
+
+    @property
+    def local_rows(self) -> int:
+        return (self.rows + self.size - 1) // self.size
+
+    @property
+    def start(self) -> int:
+        return min(self.rank * self.local_rows, self.rows)
+
+    @property
+    def stop(self) -> int:
+        return min((self.rank + 1) * self.local_rows, self.rows)
+
+    @property
+    def query_rows(self) -> slice:
+        return slice(self.start, self.stop)
+
+    @property
+    def actual_rows(self) -> int:
+        return self.stop - self.start
+
+    def select(self, tensor: torch.Tensor, *, value=0, pad: bool = True):
+        assert tensor.shape[0] >= self.rows
+        local = tensor[self.query_rows]
+        if not pad or local.shape[0] == self.local_rows:
+            return local
+        padding = [0, 0] * (tensor.ndim - 1) + [0, self.local_rows - local.shape[0]]
+        return F.pad(local, padding, value=value)
+
+    def gather(self, local: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        from sglang.srt.layers.cp.interleave import attn_cp_interleave_gather
+
+        assert local.shape[0] == self.local_rows
+        # The existing helper gathers in rank order without interleave reordering.
+        return attn_cp_interleave_gather(local)[: self.rows]
+
+

+    if not use_cp_decode_attn_dp(forward_batch):

+"""Exercise compact bounded-replay output gathering using simulated CP ranks."""
+
+import unittest
+from contextlib import nullcontext
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.deepseek_v4_backend import (
+    DeepseekV4AttnBackend,
+    LateLayerTail,
+)
+from sglang.srt.layers.cp.interleave import InterleaveCPStrategy
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardMode
+from sglang.srt.models.deepseek_v4 import DeepseekV4ForCausalLM
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+BACKEND = "sglang.srt.layers.attention.deepseek_v4_backend"
+MODEL = "sglang.srt.models.deepseek_v4"
+INTERLEAVE = "sglang.srt.layers.cp.interleave"
+CP = "sglang.srt.layers.cp.utils"
+
+
+class TestDSV41CPTail(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_tail_gather_preserves_dspark_global_indices_and_empty_ranks(self):
+        cp_size = 8
+        token_indices = torch.tensor([0, 1, 16, 17, 18, 19])
+        lengths = torch.tensor([2, 3, 1])
+        # These are global logical tail rows. The collective below packs them
+        # rank-major; the real gather_index must restore request order.
+        global_outputs = [
+            torch.stack(
+                [token_indices.float() + k, token_indices.float() + k + 0.5], -1
+            )
+            for k in range(3)
+        ]
+        global_outputs.append(token_indices)
+        for rank in range(cp_size):
+            with self.subTest(rank=rank):
+                full_cp = object()
+                batch = SimpleNamespace(
+                    batch_size=3,
+                    forward_mode=ForwardMode.EXTEND,
+                    positions=torch.arange(20),
+                    input_ids=torch.arange(20) + 100,
+                    attn_cp_metadata=full_cp,
+                    return_logprob=False,
+                )
+                parallel = SimpleNamespace(
+                    attn_cp_rank=rank, attn_cp_size=cp_size, attn_cp_group=None
+                )
+                backend = object.__new__(DeepseekV4AttnBackend)
+                with patch(f"{BACKEND}.get_parallel", return_value=parallel):
+                    layout = backend._late_layer_tail_cp_layout(
+                        batch, token_indices, lengths
+                    )
+                meta = layout["cp_metadata"]
+                tail = LateLayerTail(
+                    token_indices=layout["local_token_indices"],
+                    positions=layout["local_positions"],
+                    extend_seq_lens=lengths,
+                    extend_seq_lens_cpu=lengths.tolist(),
+                    swa_out_cache_loc=torch.empty(0),
+                    pad_rows=layout["pad_rows"],
+                    cp_metadata=meta,
+                    local_lens_cpu=layout["local_lens_cpu"],
+                )
+                strategy = InterleaveCPStrategy(cp_size=cp_size)
+                owned = token_indices % cp_size == rank
+                physical = meta.per_rank_actual_token[rank]
+
+                def local_tensor(value, owned=owned, physical=physical):
+                    local = value[owned]
+                    pad = local.new_zeros((physical - local.shape[0], *local.shape[1:]))
+                    return torch.cat([local, pad])
+
+                peer_outputs = iter(global_outputs)
+
+                def gather(out, local):
+                    value = next(peer_outputs)
+                    chunks = []
+                    for r in range(cp_size):
+                        chunk = value[token_indices % cp_size == r]
+                        padding = chunk.new_zeros(
+                            (physical - len(chunk), *chunk.shape[1:])
+                        )
+                        chunks.append(torch.cat([chunk, padding]))
+                    chunks[rank] = local
+                    out.copy_(torch.cat(chunks))
+
+                def logits(input_ids, hidden, lm_head, metadata, aux, **kwargs):
+                    return SimpleNamespace(
+                        next_token_logits=hidden @ lm_head, hidden_states=aux
+                    )
+
+                head = torch.tensor([[1.0, 2.0], [3.0, 4.0]])
+                model = SimpleNamespace(
+                    capture_aux_hidden_states=True,
+                    model=SimpleNamespace(late_layer_start=21),
+                    logits_processor=logits,
+                    lm_head=head,
+                )
+                with (
+                    patch(
+                        f"{MODEL}.get_attn_backend",
+                        return_value=SimpleNamespace(
+                            tail_forward_metadata=SimpleNamespace(late_layer_tail=tail)
+                        ),
+                    ),
+                    patch(f"{MODEL}.get_parallel", return_value=parallel),
+                    patch(
+                        f"{MODEL}.LogitsMetadata",
+                        SimpleNamespace(from_forward_batch=lambda _: SimpleNamespace()),
+                    ),
+                    patch("torch.cuda.current_stream", return_value=None),
+                    patch(f"{CP}.is_cp_active", return_value=True),
+                    patch(f"{CP}.get_cp_strategy", return_value=strategy),
+                    # cp_rank is inherited from the base strategy and reads
+                    # its module's runtime context, not an instance attribute.
+                    patch(
+                        "sglang.srt.layers.cp.base.get_parallel", return_value=parallel
+                    ),
+                    patch(f"{INTERLEAVE}.get_parallel", return_value=parallel),
+                    patch(
+                        f"{INTERLEAVE}.use_symmetric_memory", return_value=nullcontext()
+                    ),
+                    patch(f"{INTERLEAVE}.is_allocation_symmetric", return_value=False),
+                    patch(
+                        f"{INTERLEAVE}.attn_cp_all_gather_into_tensor",
+                        side_effect=gather,
+                    ),
+                ):
+                    out = DeepseekV4ForCausalLM.logits_from_cp_hidden_states(
+                        model,
+                        (
+                            local_tensor(global_outputs[0]),
+                            local_tensor(global_outputs[1]),
+                        ),
+                        local_tensor(global_outputs[2]),
+                        batch,
+                    )
+                torch.testing.assert_close(
+                    out.hidden_states_token_indices, token_indices
+                )
+                torch.testing.assert_close(
+                    out.next_token_logits, global_outputs[0] @ head
+                )
+                torch.testing.assert_close(out.hidden_states, global_outputs[2])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""H20 Torch fallback consumes rank-local CP request ownership."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsv4.v41_indexer.full_topk import FullTopKIndexer
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsv4.v41_indexer.scoring import prefill_k_slots
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsv4.v41_indexer.types import PrefillInputs
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestTorchCPIndexer(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_unequal_local_rows_empty_request_causality_and_pool_slots(self):
+        for ratio in (1, 2):
+            with self.subTest(compress_ratio=ratio):
+                # Request 3 has no queries on this CP rank; pool IDs are sparse.
+                reqs = torch.tensor([1, 3, 5])
+                positions = torch.tensor([0, 4, 2])
+                table = torch.arange(6 * 16).reshape(6, 16) * ratio
+                raw = torch.full((3, 6), 999, dtype=torch.int32)
+                pages = raw.clone()
+                seq_lens = [5, 7, 3]
+
+                def keys(layer_id, slots):
+                    return torch.arange(len(slots)).float().view(-1, 1)
+
+                indexer = SimpleNamespace(
+                    index_topk=6,
+                    queries=lambda q, freqs: q,
+                    head_weights=lambda x: x,
+                    scores=lambda q, k, weights: k.T.expand(len(q), -1),
+                )
+                inputs = PrefillInputs(
+                    indexer=indexer,
+                    layer_id=0,
+                    compress_ratio=ratio,
+                    freqs_cis=torch.ones(16, 1),
+                    x=torch.ones(3, 1),
+                    q_lora=torch.ones(3, 1),
+                    positions=positions,
+                    req_rows=None,
+                    req_pool_indices=reqs,
+                    kv_page_table=torch.empty(0),
+                    k_slots=prefill_k_slots(
+                        req_to_token=table,
+                        req_pool_indices=reqs,
+                        seq_lens_cpu=seq_lens,
+                        ratio=ratio,
+                    ),
+                    index_plans=None,
+                    seq_lens_cpu=seq_lens,
+                    rows_per_request=[2, 0, 1],
+                    rows_per_request_device=torch.tensor([2, 0, 1]),
+                    out_raw_indices=raw,
+                    out_page_indices=pages,
+                )
+                backend = object.__new__(FullTopKIndexer)
+                backend.token_to_kv_pool = SimpleNamespace(
+                    get_low_ratio_index_k_dequant=keys
+                )
+                backend.req_to_token = table
+                backend._torch_prefill(inputs)
+                for row, req in enumerate((1, 1, 5)):
+                    visible = (int(positions[row]) + 1) // ratio
+                    chosen = set(raw[row].tolist()) - {-1}
+                    self.assertEqual(chosen, set(range(visible)))
+                    expected_slots = {
+                        int(table[req, i * ratio]) // ratio for i in chosen
+                    }
+                    self.assertEqual(set(pages[row].tolist()) - {-1}, expected_slots)
+                    self.assertEqual(int((raw[row] == -1).sum()), 6 - visible)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
